display.purpose: The person's name and the Haven wordmark on sign-in. Largest type in the product.

title.purpose: The Haven wordmark in the app header. Quiet brand presence.

body.purpose: Everything read or typed: inputs, rows, button labels, context.

label.purpose: Field labels and helper copy, always in Muted gray.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: A surface truly lifted off the page: the sign-in card, future modals or sheets. Large, soft, diffuse.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft Signal Blue ring on a focused input. Feedback, not decoration.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Everything entering or responding: presses, focus, fades, screen entrances.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen movement only: the name morph, ambient pulses.

motion.name: t-screen
motion.purpose: Screen entrance fallback without view transitions.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: The sign-in card entrance, the one rare arrival.

motion.name: name-morph
motion.purpose: The tapped name traveling from row to detail title.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action worth taking on a screen: Save, Add, Sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #0071e3); border: none; border-radius: 980px; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet treatment for Back, Sign out, and the mode toggle; never competes with the primary pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 400 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--accent-text, #0069d5); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 980px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The live search box and the link/context fields. Large, forgiving, calm until focused.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search a name, or type a new one" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font: 400 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #6e6e73); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #0071e3); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Result Row
components.description: A full-width tappable person in the search results list.
components.css: .ds-result-row { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; font: 400 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-result-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #1d1d1f) 3%, var(--surface, #fff)); } .ds-result-row:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-result-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 25%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Haven is a calm, private space where a person is gently handed back to you. The whole visual system exists to get out of the way: the search box and the person are the heroes, and every other pixel steps back so they can lead. Depth is soft, color is rare, and motion only ever confirms that something happened. The palette is drawn from Apple's platform conventions on purpose -- familiarity is the feature. The Quiet Room explicitly rejects two neighbors: it is not a social network, and it is not a CRM. These are relationships, not leads, and Haven never grades how well you know someone.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first: one primary action per screen, chrome recedes.
Familiar by design: the system font stack and platform-native blue.
Flat surfaces, soft lift: hairline borders at rest, gentle shadow only when something floats.
Rare accent: a single blue, spent only on the primary action, focus, and selection.
Light and dark as equals, following the system preference.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only saturated color in the product outside the error state's Quiet Red. If a screen shows blue in two unrelated places, one of them is wrong. Its rarity is what makes the primary action unmistakable.

rules.name: The Muted-Is-Not-Body Rule
rules.body: Muted gray (#6e6e73) is for labels and helper text only. Body text is always Ink. Muted gray running as body copy is the fastest way to make a calm interface read as washed-out and hard to read.

rules.name: The Size-And-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from boxes, rules, or color. If a heading needs a border or a background tint to read as important, the size and weight are wrong.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest carries a hairline border and no shadow. Shadow is a response to state (a panel that floats, a control that has focus), never a default coat of paint.

dos: Do spend Signal Blue only on the primary action, focus, and selection. One blue per screen.
Do keep one primary action per screen; let the search box and the person lead.
Do use Ink for anything meant to be read, and reserve Muted (#6e6e73) for labels and helper text only.
Do keep surfaces flat with a hairline border at rest; add shadow only when something floats or takes focus.
Do hold body text and placeholders at 4.5:1 contrast or better (WCAG 2.2 AA), and give every control a visible focus state.
Do keep motion between 140ms (presses) and 280ms (the name morph) on the strong ease-out curve, and honor prefers-reduced-motion with an instant, non-animated fallback.
donts: Don't build anything that reads as a social network -- no feeds, likes, follower counts, activity streams, or engagement mechanics.
Don't build anything that reads as a CRM or sales tool -- no pipelines, deal stages, lead scoring, or dashboards of metrics.
Don't show a health score, closeness ranking, streak, or 'reconnect before you lose them' nudge. Haven holds memory; it never grades a relationship.
Don't run Muted gray as body text on a tinted surface; it reads as washed-out and fails contrast. Body is Ink.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or gradient text. The system is one blue on neutrals.
Don't add ambient drop shadows to ordinary cards and rows, or use a tight dark 2014-style shadow anywhere.
